title: Update manifest documentation
description:
Plan Context: Replace per-store auto-increment numeric `id` on knowledge insights with UUID v4 strings, eliminating cross-store ID collisions and enabling stable IDs across moves/copies.

Description: Update the MCP server project manifest documents and the root `AGENTS.md` Knowledge Collection cross-system dependency entry to reflect UUID-based insight IDs, removal of `next_id`, removal of `formatInsightId()`, and `moveInsight()` ID preservation. Update `file-tree.md` annotations.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md`
- `mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md`
- `mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md`
- `mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/file-tree.md`

Deliverables:
- `api-surface.md`: `InsightSchema.id` documented as `z.string().uuid()`, `KnowledgeStoreSchema` without `next_id`, `formatInsightId()` removed, `parseKnowledgeId()` return type and validation updated, `moveInsight()` documents ID preservation, tool schema tables updated, `formatted_id` references removed.
- `constraints.md`: Knowledge store IDs documented as UUID v4, `next_id` removal noted, numeric ID references updated.
- `data-flows.md`: `next_id` counter logic removed from knowledge store data flow, `moveInsight()` flow shows ID preservation, `addInsight()` flow shows UUID generation.
- `file-tree.md`: `formatInsightId` annotation removed from `knowledge.ts` entry, "numeric insight id" / "numeric id" replaced with "UUID" in `knowledge.ts` and `cross-device-portability.test.ts` annotations.

Estimated Complexity: Medium

Notes: This WP is independent of code changes and can be done in parallel with WP-002 through WP-006. The documentation pipeline stage of this WP covers the changelog entry and root `AGENTS.md` cross-system dependency update for the Knowledge Collection entry.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No mention of `next_id`, `formatInsightId`, `formatted_id`, or `KN-NNNN` in any of the four manifest documents (except historical context if appropriate).
`moveInsight()` documentation states that the original UUID is preserved across moves.
`data-flows.md` knowledge store flows show UUID generation via `crypto.randomUUID()` instead of auto-increment counter.

summary: Updated all four MCP server manifest documents to document UUID-based insight IDs.

api-surface.md: Removed nextId() method and ID Generation section from KnowledgeStoreManager; updated addInsight to document UUID v4 via randomUUID(); updated updateInsight/moveInsight/deleteInsight signatures to id: string; updated InsightSchema.id to z.ZodString (UUID v4); removed next_id from KnowledgeStoreSchema; updated MultiStoreManager dedup comments; removed Id collision note; updated all handler docs (handleUpdateKnowledge, handleDeleteKnowledge, handlePromoteKnowledge, handleMoveKnowledge) to reference UUID IDs and UUID preservation on move; updated parseKnowledgeId docs.
data-flows.md: All UUID-related flows updated in previous session (crypto.randomUUID replaces counter, no formatted_id, no next_id).
file-tree.md: Annotations updated in previous session to reflect UUID v4 strings.
constraints.md: New §73aa added documenting UUID v4 insight ID invariant.
mcp-server/changelog.md: Added v2.8.0 entry documenting the UUID migration.

comments.note: Line 772 of api-surface.md retains 'No `formatted_id` field is included' — this is acceptable per the AC's 'except historical context' allowance; it clarifies the absence of the old field for migrating users.
